ratio.hint: Ratio = uploaded ÷ downloaded. 1.00 or more means you gave back at least as much as you got.

settings.startWithWindowsHint: Peerly starts minimized and keeps seeding

settings.maxActiveDownloadsHint: The rest wait in the queue. 0 — unlimited
settings.ratioLimitHint: When a torrent has uploaded this much
settings.seedTimeLimitHint: Counted from when the download finished

settings.deleteTorrentAfterAddHint: Peerly keeps its own copy, the original file isn't needed

settings.altSpeedHint: A second pair of speed limits — e.g. so torrents don't get in the way during the day
settings.ipFilterHint: A blocklist file of addresses to block (P2P and eMule formats)
